name: Tract Analysis Profiles - Dipy
summary: Computes tract profiles of tensor, NODDI, myelin or quantitative MRI measures along segmented white matter tracts with DIPY Gaussian-weighted profiling, producing per-tract plots, profile CSVs and a tractmeasures CSV.
description: For each tract in a white matter classification (wmc), orients the streamlines to a QuickBundles centroid, resamples them to num_nodes points and averages each measure with DIPY's Gaussian distance weights (afq_profile style). Writes PNG plots per tract and measure, per-tract profile CSVs and a single tractmeasures CSV. Use it after tract segmentation; it needs the wmc, the tck it was derived from, the reference DWI and at least one measure input (tensor, NODDI, myelin or qMRI).

inputs.description: The path to the reference dwi for the tractography. Used for the affine header
The path to the wmc classification datatype
The path to the tractogram corresponding to the wmc structure
The path to the tensor datatype files
The path to the NODDI datatype files (optional)
Optional myelin map sampled along each tract.
Optional quantitative MRI maps sampled along each tract.

outputs.description: Directory of tract profile images for each tract and measure
Directory of tract profile csvs for each tract and measure
CSV containing all tracts and measures

parameters.description: Number of nodes for tract profiles

citations.text: Yeatman JD, Dougherty RF, Myall NJ, Wandell BA, Feldman HM (2012) Tract Profiles of White Matter Properties: Automating Fiber-Tract Quantification. PLoS ONE 7(11): e49790.

failure_modes.fix: Check the log of tractAnalysisProfilesDipy.py for the failing tract or measure.
